instruments.name: Handheld sucrose refractometer
instruments.notes: Local action names model operator use of the front-panel ZERO and READ keys.

documents.title: Hanna HI96801 manual, MAN96801 04/17, pp. 10–13, 17 (source notes)
documents.text:
At the start of a measurement day, calibration requires distilled or deionized water covering the prism. With the meter on and ready, ZERO should yield a zero display without an error. The calibration water is removed with soft tissue and the prism dried.
A plastic pipette protects the prism from scratches. A measurement uses a dry prism with the sample well filled and prism covered. READ displays the Brix result; allow thermal equilibration if the sample and meter differ appreciably in temperature. A blinking ATC indication means temperature compensation is inactive.
Between samples the well and prism are rinsed using distilled or deionized water and dried with soft tissue. An Air indication means insufficient coverage; an error display is not a sample result.

documents.title: Schorn-García et al., Foods 12, 962 (2023), §2.3 (source notes)
documents.text: The authors measured total soluble solids of individual grape berries at room temperature with a Hanna HI96801. Each berry supplied its own expressed juice. The water-zeroed refractometer was cleaned and dried for each new reading. The individual berry was the sampling unit in this part of the study.

experiment.title: Compare soluble solids in two delivered grape lots
experiment.goal: Compare apparent total soluble solids in delivered samples from grape lots A and B by refractometry.

documents.title: Teaching intake and reporting brief
documents.source: Illustrative lab inventory and study brief
documents.text:
Six separate berry-juice specimens per lot are already expressed, at room temperature, and labeled with lot and berry IDs. A separate equal-volume composite for each lot is also on hand from the same six specimens. No additional collection or sample preparation is required. The two sample sets represent alternative sampling units.
One valid reading per selected specimen is requested. Record specimen ID and displayed Brix. Compare lot A minus lot B in degrees Brix. For individual specimens the comparison uses the arithmetic mean within each lot. Only these delivered specimens are in scope. Plastic pipettes, deionized water, soft tissues and a results sheet are available.
